title: Knowledge-distillation golf

paper.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Knowledge-distillation golf: compress a frozen teacher using temperature-scaled KL and a small student parameter cap. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cifar10; required output: Image -> student logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Frozen teacher temperature-squared KL scaling; quality versus student parameter count. Required ablation: Compare hard labels alone with soft-target distillation at equal student compute. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
